## Setup Checklist (100% free stack)
No OpenAI / LLM is used anywhere in this workflow — it's pure button-and-logic flow.

### 1. Facebook
- Facebook Developer App → Messenger → Webhooks, subscribe to `messages` and `messaging_postbacks`.
- Point the webhook at the **Messenger Message Webhook** node URL (POST).
- Verify Token: set in **Check Verify Token** node, point Facebook's verify callback at **Messenger Verify Webhook** (GET, same path).
- Get a Page Access Token, put it in **Send Reply to Messenger**. If your old token was ever pasted/shared anywhere outside n8n, regenerate it in Meta for Developers first.

### 2. Google Sheet (acts as your free database)
Column headers must be EXACTLY `senderId` (lowercase s, capital I, lowercase d) in both Sessions and Bookings tabs — casing must match exactly or lookups silently fail.

**Sessions** — columns: senderId, step, name, address, phone, email, service, serviceDuration, date, time, updatedAt

**Services** — columns: name, payload, durationMinutes. Example rows:
| name | payload | durationMinutes |
|---|---|---|
| Haircut | HAIRCUT | 30 |
| Massage | MASSAGE | 60 |
| Consultation | CONSULT | 45 |

**Bookings** — columns: senderId, name, address, phone, email, service, date, time, createdAt

### 3. Google Calendar
- Add Google Calendar OAuth2 credential to both Calendar nodes.
- Any existing event on that calendar counts as BUSY. Block yourself off by adding an event (lunch, day off, existing booking) — the bot will not offer those times.

### 4. Business config
Open the **Conversation Engine** code node and edit the constants at the top: business hours, open days, slot interval, days ahead to show.

### Facebook quick reply rules (important!)
Quick reply button titles must be 20 characters or fewer, or Facebook silently rejects the whole message. This version auto-truncates every button title to 20 chars, but keep your Service names short and readable within that limit.
